title: verdict v1
description: A tier-2 verdict: the host's answer to a verdict-request, or a merge-gate result. Reads artifacts, never opinions; bound to the exact sha validated; produced by a non-author.

request.description: The ticket id this verdict answers.

subject.description: What was validated — the artifact under test (a tree, an image, a live service).

sha.description: The exact head sha the verdict is bound to. A verdict unbound from a sha decides nothing.

kind.description: The class of artifact the evidence reads.

ref.description: Where the artifact lives — a log path, a command line whose output is attached, a digest, or a resolvable reference.

evidence.description: At least one artifact. A verdict without evidence is testimony and is refused.

by.description: The non-author identity that produced the verdict (the host's validator, or the merge gate executor).
